principles: The 1928/1929 association and FIFA milestones are pre-1955 institutional context; the 1948 state transition is preserved explicitly.
AFC admission in 1956, exit in 1974 and UEFA full membership in 1994 are distinct competition-governance phases.
FIFA Big Count 2006 and Professional Football Report 2023 are strictly gated to their observation years.
No ranking, World Cup or confederation tournament outcome is used as a calibration target.
9+ remains world-leading and is not reached by this evidence set.
